info.title: Payment Orchestrator API
info.description: HTTP API for submitting payment requests to the payment process.

post.description: Validates the payment request, trims leading and trailing whitespace from its string fields, and publishes a PaymentInitiatedFact message to Zeebe. A successful response confirms the publish call completed; it does not confirm that the message correlated with a process instance or report the eventual process outcome. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB.

202.description: The Zeebe message publication call succeeded. This does not confirm that a process instance was created or report the payment outcome.

400.description: The body is invalid JSON, exceeds 16 KiB, or contains invalid payment fields.

404.description: The requested method or path is not handled by the service.

503.description: The service could not publish the payment start message to Zeebe.

post.summary: Submit a payment with per-instance test behavior
post.description: Test-only endpoint for selecting a FraudCheck result and simulated worker failures for one payment instance. The test settings are passed to workers as test-prefixed process variables. Manual review decisions still require completing the user task through its externally managed form. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB.

202.description: The Zeebe message publication call succeeded. This does not confirm that a process instance was created or report the payment outcome.

400.description: The body is invalid JSON, exceeds 16 KiB, or contains invalid payment or test fields.

404.description: The requested method or path is not handled by the service.

503.description: The service could not publish the payment start message to Zeebe.

PaymentInitiationRequest.title: [Payment Orchestrator] PaymentInitiationRequest
PaymentInitiationRequest.description: Payment variables required by the PaymentInitiatedFact BPMN start message.

payment_id.description: Payment identifier passed to the process variables and used as the Zeebe message ID. The value is trimmed before publication.

payer_id.description: Payer identifier. The value is trimmed before publication.

payee_id.description: Payee identifier. The value is trimmed before publication.

currency.description: Payment currency code. The value is trimmed before publication.

PaymentTestRequest.title: [Payment Orchestrator] PaymentTestRequest
PaymentTestRequest.description: Payment initiation fields plus test behavior for one process instance.

PaymentTestSettings.title: [Payment Orchestrator] PaymentTestSettings
PaymentTestSettings.description: Per-instance worker behavior. Omitted settings default to approved, no failure, and zero transient failures.

failure_at.description: Task at which to simulate a permanent failure. Refund and rollback failures take effect only if the process reaches those tasks.

transient_refund_failures.description: Number of transient REFUND_PAYER failures before it succeeds.

transient_rollback_failures.description: Number of transient ROLLBACK_PAYMENT_STATUS failures before it succeeds.

payment_id.description: Trimmed payment identifier from the accepted request.

status.description: Indicates that the orchestrator completed the Zeebe message publication call.
